name: Suwano Natsumi
source:
The best student in the whole class. Her grades truly are impressive. She is useless in sports, however.
Once class is over, she usually attends private lessons.
She is a gentle, polite girl.
Michiyo and her have been friends forever. Some say that Kei and her are an item...

[From in-game charater profile]

A member of class 503.
